purpose: R15 AI-resistant current trade/landed-cost workflows; current HTS/origin/value/rule data rather than static informational content

hard_gates.ai_resilience: prefer workflows requiring product classification, origin, customs value, current tariff layers and current rule tables
hard_gates.reject: generic import-duty/HS-code seeds already scanned in customs-import

themes.label: Landed Cost / HTS Duty Workflow
themes.ai_resilience_reason: Requires current HTS, origin, value, duty layers and freight/fees to compute a usable landed cost.

themes.label: Section 301 / China Tariff Workflow
themes.ai_resilience_reason: Current tariff applicability depends on HTS classification, origin and active exclusion/tariff lists.

themes.label: De Minimis Import Workflow
themes.ai_resilience_reason: Current threshold/rule applicability depends on country, shipment value, product and current customs policy.

themes.label: Anti-Dumping / Countervailing Duty Workflow
themes.ai_resilience_reason: Current case/order scope, country, exporter and product classification determine applicable duties.
